title: Kenworth W900 SAR Legend FUPS Compliant Polished Hi-Tensile Aluminium Bullbar
description: Kenworth Legend W900 SAR Custom Built high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS compliant Bullbar. 78mm diameter one piece main cross pipes passing through drilled uprights for maximum strength, no butt welds, 80mm & 100mm diameter pipe available as option. Hi-tensile box uprights, custom designed 381mm deep heavy duty main channel with lower skirt and provision for front mudflaps. Heavy duty hi-tensile aluminium backing plate with 35mm tow pin. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements. Helper spring fitted to assist with raising and lowering Bullbar. Bullbar can be custom built to your requirements.
